**In one line:** US proposals target student work fees while bank loan costs rise in India following the central bank rate hike.

- **Cloudflare acquired server software maker Deno** to expand its developer cloud tools.

## 13. One idea to understand today
**Closing Auction Session (CAS)** — In stock markets, calculating the final closing price matters because mutual funds and index trackers value portfolios at that level. Usually, exchanges take an average price during the final 30 minutes of trading. A closing auction lets buyers and sellers place orders in a dedicated matching window right before the market shuts. This concentrates trading volume in one pool and prevents single large trades from artificially manipulating closing prices. SEBI is introducing CAS to ensure fair settlement valuations for derivatives and equities.
